outcome: Professors can publish to the Showcase through the MCP
owner_impact: You asked that Showcase curation not require the Lab's button. The MCP now has a manage_showcase tool: list the Showcase (it shows which of your entries are behind their Experiment's current revision), publish the current revision of one of your Experiments, or remove it. It calls the same database functions as the Lab's buttons, signed in as you, so only Professors can publish, and only their own Experiments; students see the tool and get a refusal. I used it to republish Constant Bearing Flocking and Firat's aggregation at their migrated revisions. Test now: yes. Open Constant Bearing Flocking from the Showcase; the setup message should read 'Groups: informed 80, uninformed 120'. In GPT you can ask it to publish or list the Showcase (the connector may need a refresh to see the new tool).
